description: You are a product manager drafting the Q3 strategy memo your CEO asked for. In Apple Pages, create a new document and type these three priority lines into the body (bulleted or plain lines both accepted): 1) 'Launch AI-assisted onboarding by 2026-09-30', 2) 'Raise NPS from 42 to 55 with quarterly user-research sprints', 3) 'Reduce P0 incident rate by 30% via on-call rotation overhaul'. Then save the document as 'Q3 Product Strategy Memo.pages' in the Documents folder (full path: /Users/lume/Documents/Q3 Product Strategy Memo.pages). The document must contain the literal phrases above so a reviewer can locate the commitments; the date '2026-09-30', the metric 'NPS from 42 to 55', and the phrase 'P0 incident rate' / '30%' are required.
